name: Shoot for the Stars: A community-based approach to Sunflower Star Recovery
dateTimeSentence: Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 6:00 PM PST
description:
Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability | Hopkins Marine Station is hosting Reuven Bank, the Executive Director of the Sunflower Star Laboratory, for a guest lecture on Tuesday, November 17th at 6 PM.

Hear Reuven detail how sunflower star recovery is integral to restoring California’s vanishing kelp forests, and how Sunflower Star Laboratory’s experienced, interdisciplinary team leads groundbreaking work to make this imperative a reality.

Sunflower Star Laboratory is a community-based nonprofit that leads research and conservation to recover the sunflower star and build kelp forest resilience with our communities. They are actively growing the critically endangered sunflower star and other species in our conservation aquaculture facility in Moss Landing, CA, while conducting research and coordinating greater sunflower star recovery efforts across North America.

name: Big Ballers: Dinner with Entrepreneurs | Menlo Park
dateTimeSentence: Friday, November 13, 2026 at 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM PST
description:
Organized by: BarCada — https://www.eventbrite.com/o/108253026661

Join us for a cozy dinner with local entrepreneurs to network, share experiences, and make new connections!

Hey, Ballers!

When was the last time you did something completely spontaneous? Our series groups together complete strangers for a fun night out to connect with like-minded individuals. You sign up, and we book the restaurant. Our mission is to host dinners in over 100 cities to bring people together while supporting locally owned businesses. This micro-event is intended to be for 6 people or less. Check out our feature in Eventbrite's 2025 TRNDS report about embracing the micro-event trend.

This gathering isn't an official event with the restaurant but rather an outing based on a table reservation. The pin on the map is not the location, but a placeholder on Eventbrite as each week is held at a different location.

Our feature on Fox 11 Los Angeles.

Please see here for our coverage in Nashville Fox 17's Growing Nashville segment.

How does it work?

After you register, you'll be emailed an introduction message.

*Your registration does not include your individual food and drink purchases. A paid ticket simply makes you more committed to actually showing up.

*These outings are intended to help people make friends. These are not singles gatherings.

*If we don't meet our minimum number of registrants for the evening you sign up, please be open to joining us on another evening! We will complete table reservations after we hit our minimum signups, so you may reach out to us before signing up for or after you sign up to see our progress with registrations for the evening.

*If you sign up the day of the gathering and do not get a message from us in time, simply email ermantourageimpact@gmail.com, request a refund, or please be open to joining us on another evening.

Our vision is simple: we take the no gimmicks approach to networking. No need for yet another app to take up space on your phone - just four walls and a roof and good food for people to connect :) We coordinate with you directly, human-to-human.

If you have any more questions, please contact ermantourageimpact@gmail.com!

(Become a monthly member via Patreon for exclusive community gatherings not listed on this calendar, and for community chat rooms to connect with other entrepreneurs, instead of registering a la carte here!)

name: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1: Drawing with Time and Rhythm
dateTimeSentence: Sunday, November 22, 2026 at 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM PST
description:
In this one-hour figure-drawing workshop, participants will draw together with pencils for 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 minute—and sometimes even 30 seconds. We will begin with longer drawing times and slowly move to shorter, faster ones. Participants can try different pencil pressure, movement, and speed as the timing  changes. Participants may volunteer to pose for the group. As we draw, we will watch different poses and body movements and follow the changing rhythm  together. The timing will be repeated about three times.

Participants will make several drawings on 11 × 14-inch paper and one larger drawing on 18 × 24-inch paper, arranging several figures on one sheet. The workshop is open to adults of all levels. No drawing experience is needed.

name: Online lecture: "Henry Hobson Richardson: Drawings from the Collection of Houghton Library, Harvard
dateTimeSentence: Saturday 14 November 2026 at 14:00 EST
description:
Join us for our seventh season of FREE online lectures, beginning Saturday, November 14th!

This lecture will discuss the first in-depth publication of drawings by H. H. Richardson, the greatest American architect of the nineteenth century. The trove of over 4,000 drawings, preserved since Richardson’s death in the Houghton Rare Book Library at Harvard, have been largely unpublished until now. The book presents full-color reproductions of 450 sketches and renderings by the Boston-based architect and his talented assistants, who included Charles McKim and Stanford White. It includes more than 50 projects, including such masterpieces as Boston’s Trinity Church; Sever and Austin Halls at Harvard; the Stoughton House in Cambridge; the Allegheny County Courthouse and Jail in Pittsburgh; the Marshall Field Store and Glessner House in Chicago; and five small public libraries.

The authors will discuss the Richardson drawings and what they reveal about the collaborative design process in Richardson’s studio, with a focus on Austin Hall at Harvard Law School as a compelling case study. The book has received the 2025 Book Prize from the Victorian Society in America and the 2025 Honor Book Award from Historic New England.

*** This lecture is part of the VSA's 2026-27 Online Lecture Series. All lectures are offered for FREE with online registration. Lectures are recorded and made available for viewing for two weeks after the live presentations. 

Visit https://victoriansociety.org/lectures-7/ for links to recordings and information on other lectures in this series.

Also, playing tennis will be a chance for your child to build endurance and coordination. This program is only for the students attending the school and is not open to the public.

Our program is meant for beginners in Gr 3rd-5th. We will be using and providing modified equipment (18ft portable net, smaller racquets, and low compression red balls) for your child to learn the fundamentals of tennis at their level.

We know most children will only enjoy tennis if they are having fun while doing so, which is our coaches’ main focus. We want to make sure every child becomes as passionate about tennis as our coaches are. Our coaches work incredibly hard to make sure your child becomes the best tennis player they can be.

name: Sol Horizon's Bob Marley Birthday Tribute at The Guild
dateTimeSentence: Friday 5 February 2027 from 20:00-23:00 PST
description:
Sol Horizon is Sonoma County, California’s best reggae band and Northern California’s premier Bob Marley tribute band. The band was voted “Best Band” in the North Bay Bohemian’s “Best of the North Bay” Reader’s Picks in 2022 and 2023 and awarded the NorBay Award for “Best Reggae Band” in the North Bay 9 times, including the last 5 years in a row and 8 of the previous 9 years. Their renowned Bob Marley tribute pays homage to the global voice of reggae, celebrating his life and legacy through performances of his greatest music. The tribute expands from an 8-piece original music band to a 12-piece band featuring an additional keyboardist, 2 female background vocalists, and 2 horns. The band continues to expand its offering of Bob Marley classics, from well-known chart-toppers to more rare cuts and versions, mixing in subtle musical interpretations and blazing solos to keep the crowd on its toes. Don’t miss this tribute to the worldwide voice of reggae music!

–

Doors 7PM // Show 8PM

General Admission is standing room only. Mezzanine is on the second floor, reserved and fully seated. For more information please contact ticketing@guildtheatre.com
